body:
AngryBlock Mod
Core Features:
Hostile Blocks - Random attack penalties when breaking blocks
Valuable Mob Drops - 1 in 3 chance for rare items (diamonds, netherite, etc.)
Player Commands - /mobdrop to control drops in-game
Customization:
Configurable effect chances
Adjustable damage ranges
Toggle mob drops on/off
User Experience:
Chaotic gameplay - Blocks fight back
Rewarding combat - Valuable mob loot
Player control - In-game command system
Technical Specs:
Minecraft: 1.21.10
Fabric: 0.18.6+
Java: 21+
